fusions.name: Rut Toss
fusions.desc: Locks antlers with an enemy and wrenches it aside for 14 blunt damage, throwing it 3 tiles back and leaving it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed and Hurled
fusions.desc: Hurls one of your shed antlers at an enemy for 7 piercing damage. You hold 3 at a time, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Bad Handhold
fusions.desc: For 10 seconds, 50% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it. Your movement speed rises by 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Cornered Buck
fusions.desc: When non-fire damage hits you, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds. You gain 5% dodge chance.
